name: Duck Confit with Dried Cranberries & Pinion Nuts/Walnuts
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's
whyItWorks: Slow-cooked duck leg meat is tender, but high rendered duck fat combined with tough dried cranberries and walnuts triggers urgency.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If ordering in remission, eat only the shredded duck leg meat and leave all dried cranberries, nuts, and crispy skin behind.
watchOuts: Whole walnuts/pine nuts and fibrous dried cranberries
